summary: Crews remove part of a levee to give the river at {place} more room to spread out.
realLife: King County removed sections of river defenses near Fall City as part of a project protecting farms and homes.
gates: A proposed river project includes a levee next to working farmland.
weights: A narrow planting window increases the cost of blocking farm access.
inGame: needs: construction stages and nearby farm access.

turns.what: The county retains the levee along the farm.
turns.pulledBy: The landowner and county cannot agree on an easement.
turns.writesBack: The revised design keeps the barrier in place.

turns.what: Crews remove one section before planting season.
turns.pulledBy: The farm access agreement limits when heavy equipment can enter.
turns.writesBack: The remaining section goes on the next construction schedule.
